incidents.title: Decoy SSH Credential Abuse & Reconnaissance
incidents.description: Adversary attempted interactive authentication against canary SSH daemon with decoy administrator credentials.
incidents.mitigation: Automated firewall interdiction initiated. Revoke leaked credentials and isolate originating endpoint.

incidents.title: Decoy Database SQL Injection Probe
incidents.description: SQL injection payloads detected hitting decoy PostgreSQL database canary table.
incidents.mitigation: Attacker IP blocked at border gateway. Canary database connection terminated.

incidents.title: Canary AWS Access Key Token Trigger
incidents.description: Canary cloud token accessed outside approved IAM role from unknown external IP address.
incidents.mitigation: Canary token disabled. Session invalidated in AWS CloudTrail integration.
